name: Tourist / Short-Stay Visa (Schengen Type C)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave the Schengen area at the end of your visit.

sources.title: Schengen visa fees - Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs

notes: Same EUR 90 standard adult fee (children 6-11: EUR 45) as every other Schengen visitor route in this dataset — Switzerland is in Schengen despite NOT being an EU member, a genuine and important structural distinction from Ireland (an EU member that opted OUT of Schengen, the exact inverse situation), worth flagging as a real cross-country contrast when comparing 'visit' category routes. Free for family members of EU/EFTA citizens — a real fee waiver worth noting. Standard processing 15 calendar days, up to 30-60 for complex cases. Living/working/studying beyond 90 days requires a separate national Type D visa with prior cantonal (and sometimes federal) authorisation — this route cannot be converted in-country the way some other countries' visitor routes in this dataset allow. EES phased in at Swiss airports from 12 October 2025; ETIAS expected for visa-exempt travellers late 2026 — both confirmed as live operational changes worth flagging, though ETIAS specifically was not yet in force as of this verification.
